items.title: Banks Fought Against Stablecoins. Now They Are Considering Launching Their Own.
items.summary: Banks large and small have started to warm up to the idea of their own stablecoins, despite early doubts from some executives that there will be much demand for them.  Instead, banks banded together to launch a tokenized deposit system as an answer to the rapid changes in the world of payments.  Stablecoins are digital tokens pegged to the U.S. dollar or other currencies, while tokenized deposits are just traditional money represented as digital tokens.

items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Commits $1 Million To Affordable Housing In Wyoming
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has awarded a $1 million grant to the Wyoming Housing Network to support affordable housing and workforce development initiatives in Wyoming. The funding targets rural communities in the state, with a focus on addressing housing shortages and training local workers in construction related skills.
